title: Agent honeypot resistance
description: Text hidden in a document or a system's reply can make the agent move money or send data to someone else.
recommendation: Treat tool output as data, never as instructions: keep it in a separate channel, enforce payee and recipient allowlists and approvals in the tool gateway (not the prompt), and re-run these scenarios on every model or prompt change.
controls: NIST:MEASURE-2.7; NIST-GAI:INFO-SECURITY; OWASP-LLM:LLM01; OWASP-ASI:ASI01; OWASP-ASI:ASI02; ISO42001:A.6.2.4; EUAIA:Art-15

title: Agent action auditability
description: The agent took a high-impact action (such as issuing money) without a recorded human approval, and parts of its log cannot prove what happened.
recommendation: Enforce approval in the tool gateway (not in the prompt), require a parent request for every tool call, restrict tools to an allowlist, and write logs to an append-only hash chain.
controls: NIST:MEASURE-2.8; NIST:GOVERN-3.2; NIST:MANAGE-4.3; NIST:MAP-3.5; ISO42001:A.6.2.8; OWASP-LLM:LLM06; EUAIA:Art-12; EUAIA:Art-14; INDIA:SUTRA-ACCOUNTABILITY; INDIA:PILLAR-ACCOUNTABILITY; OWASP-ASI:ASI02; OWASP-ASI:ASI03

title: Agent control readiness
description: The deployment is missing safeguards the agent-safety literature expects: action monitor.
recommendation: Give the agent its own identity rather than a user's token, scope its tools with an allowlist enforced in the gateway, require human approval before irreversible actions, define conditions that stop it, write its log to a hash chain, and attach a monitor that reviews actions. Record each in the trace so the audit can see it, not only declare it.
controls: NIST:GOVERN-3.2; NIST:MAP-3.5; NIST:MANAGE-2.4; NIST:MANAGE-4.1; ISO42001:A.6.2.6; OWASP-LLM:LLM06; OWASP-ASI:ASI02; OWASP-ASI:ASI03; OWASP-ASI:ASI08; OWASP-ASI:ASI10; EUAIA:Art-14; EUAIA:Art-15; INDIA:SUTRA-SAFETY; INDIA:SUTRA-ACCOUNTABILITY

title: Agent oversight integrity
description: Data the agent read contained hidden instructions, so check whether the agent followed them.
recommendation: Log the agent's reasoning for every action, keep it legible (do not train against the monitor), and screen tool and retrieval results for instructions before they reach the model.

title: Risk classification
description: This AI system carries transparency duties: people must know they are dealing with AI.
recommendation: Record the classification and its basis in the AI inventory, have the accountable executive sign it off, and plan for each upcoming obligation.
